rationale: Anthony brings deep expertise in energy systems, AI/ML, and cyber-physical infrastructure from PG&E, while Ashia is building AI-powered tools to automate scientific validation and experimental replication. Anthony's conviction that graph neural networks outperform LLMs for structured enterprise data aligns with Ashia's focus on rigorous, validated science at scale—both see AI's real value in domain-specific, production-grade applications rather than generic models. They could explore how his infrastructure and regulatory domain knowledge might inform SymbyAI's deployment in R&D and federal lab contexts.
intro_message: Anthony James, meet Ashia Livaudais — you both are solving enterprise-scale problems where structured data and scientific rigor matter more than off-the-shelf AI, and her work automating experimental validation could benefit from your production experience in complex systems.
